description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'CloseUtils' providing methods to quietly close Closeable objects and database cursors, used for resource management in Android applications.

classes.name: CloseUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to close Closeable resources and cursors without throwing IOExceptions.

methods.name: closeQuietly(Closeable closeable)
methods.description: Closes a Closeable resource if it is not null, ignoring any IOException.

methods.name: closeQuietly(Cursor cursor)
methods.description: Closes a Cursor if it is not null.
